answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 32261 Country: India Title: Regarding Holy Quran. Question: Respected pious scholars,Here is the meaning of Surah:An-Nisa Ayah:54.Or, is it that they are jealous of people over what Allah has given them of His bounty, while We have given to the House of Ibrahim the Book and the wisdom, and We have given to them a great kingdom? whatis the house of Ibrahim?If it exists ..where it is??Explain in detail Answer ID: 32261 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1024/1024/M=1432) Here is the ayat No. 54 of Surah al-Nisa: أَمْ يَحْسُدُونَ النَّاسَ عَلَى مَا آتَاهُمُ اللّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِ فَقَدْ آتَيْنَا آلَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْكِتَابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَآتَيْنَاهُم مُّلْكاً عَظِيماً [النساء : 54] This verse makes mention of the children of Ibrahim (عليه السلام) not his house. And it means that Almighty Allah has bestowed prophethood and kingship to a group from the children of Hadhrat Ibrahim (عليه السلام). والمعنى أنه حصل في اولاد إبراهيم جماعة كبيرون جمعوا بين النبوة والملك . (تفسير كبير الجزء العاشر ص 107) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
